CustomField.description: Master switch for the centralized Financial Engine. When TRUE, the engine + self-healing triggers own the four stored totals (Invoice.Paid_Amount__c/Status__c, Receipt.Received_Amount__c, Receipt_Amount__c.Cumulative_Paid_Amount__c, Cash_Flow.Received_Amount__c) and re-derive them idempotently. When FALSE (the default), the engine's trigger writes are suppressed and the existing create flows author the totals exactly as before. Value is data, not deployed metadata: set TRUE in the working sandbox, leave FALSE in production until cutover.
CustomField.label: Engine Owns Totals
